# thumbnailprompts

> thumbnailprompts is a Claude connector (MCP server) for YouTube creators. You describe your video or paste the transcript, and Claude writes a ready-to-render thumbnail prompt — layout, typography, colors and your own face — based on a curated library of thumbnail designs that have already performed well. You paste the prompt into an image model (ChatGPT, Gemini) with your face photo to get the finished thumbnail.

Status: the website and early-access waitlist are live. The MCP connector is in development; people can join the waitlist on the homepage to get access first.

## How it works

1. Connect the MCP: add thumbnailprompts to Claude in one click.
2. Ask for a thumbnail: describe your video, and it picks a trending layout that fits the topic.
3. Paste and generate: run the prompt in ChatGPT or Gemini with your face photo.

Works with Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor.
